rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The soul’s intrusive promptings gain control only after divine admonitions are veiled and repeated corrupt intentions bury the calls of truth.
rows.anchor: لا تستولي هواجس النفوس على صاحبها إلا بعد استتار مواعظ الحق

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The soul is naturally drawn to appetite and disobedience; following it soon brings regret, which then cannot repair the harm.
rows.anchor: والنفس لا تدعو إلا إلى اتباع الشهوات ومتابعة المعصية

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: God intends people to take prudent care in livelihood and supplies a means of recognition when a subtle practical solution is unclear.
rows.anchor: إرادة الحق - سبحانه - وصول الخلق إلى لطف الاحتياط في أسباب التعيش

rows.speaker: النبي
rows.claim: The Prophet says that whoever inaugurates a good or bad practice receives its own reward or burden and that of those who follow it until the Resurrection.
rows.anchor: من سن حسنة فله أجرها وأجر من عمل بها إلى يوم والقيامة

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Corruption has outward forms, punished through the rulings of jurisprudence, and inward forms, whose punishment reaches a person’s spiritual secrets.
rows.anchor: السعي في الفساد على ضربين : بالظاهر وعقوبته معلومة في مسائل الفقه

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Inward punishment severs divine inspirations and brings eclipse of gnosis, veiling after unveiling, estrangement after intimacy, loss of enabling grace, and exclusion from worship into following the lower soul.
rows.anchor: وذلك بقطع ما كان متصلا من واردات الحق ، وكسوف شمس العرفان ، والستر بعد الكشف

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Satan’s claim of superiority should have yielded to humility, especially because the command came from the Real.
rows.anchor: ادعى الخيرية ، وكان الواجب عليه - لولا الشقوة - أن يؤثر التذلل على التكبر

words: خَلَقْتَنِى مِن نَّارٍۢ وَخَلَقْتَهُۥ مِن طِينٍۢ
rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Satan’s self-interested analogy only increased his culpability: superiority rests on God’s judgment and allotment, not on the material from which one was made.
rows.anchor: ولم يعلم أن الخيرية بحكمه - سبحانه - وقسمته

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Arrogance on the carpet of intimacy violates proper manners, and abandoning the etiquette of the divine presence warrants expulsion.
rows.anchor: فإن التكبر والترفع على البساط ترك للأدب ، وترك الأدب يوجب الطرد

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Anyone who sees personal worth or station is arrogant and distant from God; claiming a rank for oneself encroaches on divine lordship, since no one has independent worth before Him.
rows.anchor: فمن ادعى لنفسه محلا فقد نازع الربوبية

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: God answered Satan’s plea immediately as a trial and stratagem, allowing him to disobey until the Resurrection and thereby increasing his misery.
rows.anchor: أجاب دعاءه في الحال ولكن كان ذلك مكرا به

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: An answered prayer is not necessarily a favor or act of kindness; its fulfillment can be a trial and a divine stratagem.
rows.anchor: ليس كل إجابة للدعاء نعمة ولطفا بل قد تكون بلاء ومكرا

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Satan openly opposed the Real after appearing wholly sincere in servitude, showing that his former conduct had not arisen from sincerity and truth.
rows.anchor: جاهر الحقيقة بالخلاف بعدما أظهر من نفسه غاية الخلوص في العبودية

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Satan does not know that God can protect people from him; his machinations come into being through divine power and will, so his threats cannot independently harm them.
rows.anchor: ولم يعلم أن الحق سبحانه قادر على حفظهم عنه ، فإن ما يكيد بهم من القدرة حصل

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Satan’s expulsion from his rank and his eternal punishment display the overpowering force of divine sovereignty and are a story that should break the listener’s heart.
rows.anchor: أخرجه من درجته ، ومن حالته ورتبته ، ونقله إلى ما استوجبه من طرده ولعنته

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: God placed the means of trial with Adam in the Garden: his spouse and the tree of ordeal; the tree’s presence reflects the hidden mystery of divine allotment.
rows.anchor: وأي نقص يكون في الجنة لو لم يخلق فيها تلك الشجرة التي هي شجرة المحنة

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Although Adam and his spouse committed the lapse, God’s attribution of it to Satan is a sign of special divine care for them.
rows.anchor: نسبته ما حصل منهما إلى الشيطان من أمارات العناية ، كانت الخطيئة منهما

rows.speaker: آدم وإبليس
rows.claim: A reported exchange has Adam blame Satan for tempting him; Satan replies that if he was Adam’s devil, Adam should ask who was his own devil.
rows.anchor: يا شقي ! وسوست إلي وفعلت ! ، فقال إبليس لآدم . يا آدم ! هب أني إبليسك فمن كان إبليسي

words: لِيُبْدِىَ لَهُمَا مَا وُۥرِىَ عَنْهُمَا مِن سَوْءَٰتِهِمَا
rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The wording that Satan would expose their nakedness signals special care: no one besides Adam and his spouse saw it.
rows.anchor: وفي ذلك دلالة على عناية زائدة حيث قال : { ليبدى لهما } فلم يطلع على سوأتهما غيرهما

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: They longed to become angels because they imagined freedom from desire and hope, not because the angelic rank exceeded Adam’s.
rows.anchor: تاقت أنفسهما إلى أن يكونا ملكين - لا لأن رتبة الملائكة كانت أعلى من رتبة آدم عليه السلام

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Their desire for immortality brought abasement, ordeal, and fear; greed is the root of every trial, and if greed in Paradise led to such trials, greed in the transient world is even less safe.
rows.anchor: وأصل كل محنة الطمع . ويقال إذا كان الطمع في الجنة - وهي دار الخلود - أوجب كل تلك المحن

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: An alternative says they sought lasting life to remain with God rather than for personal gain; Qushayri prefers it because it preserves the dignity of prophethood.
rows.anchor: وهذا أولى لأنه يوجب تنزيه محل النبوة

rows.speaker: قيل
rows.claim: A saying describes the span of union as brief and separation as long: Adam and his spouse entered the Garden in the morning and left at midday.
rows.anchor: وقيل ساعات الوصال قصيرة وأيام الفراق طويلة ، فما لبثا في دار الوصلة إلا بعضا من النهار

rows.speaker: قائلهم
rows.claim: An anonymous poetic saying compares separation striking people of union to an evil eye that strikes beautiful things.
rows.anchor: وفي معناه قال قائلهم : إن تكن عين أصابتك فما . . . إلا لأن العين تصيب الحسنا

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Just as the lovers expected lasting joy, separation emerged from concealment and destroyed their gathered unity; an anonymous poem makes the same point.
rows.anchor: بدا الفراق من مكامنه فأباد من شملهما ما انتظم ، كما قيل : حين تم الهوى وقلنا سررنا

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Adam’s good opinion led him to trust the enemy’s oath because he could not imagine an oath sworn by God would be false; after recognizing the deception, Adam sincerely repented and admitted his offense, and God accepted him with pardon.
rows.anchor: حسن ظن آدم - عليه السلام - حمله على سكون قلبه إلى يمين العدو لأنه لم يخطر بباله أن يكذب في يمينه

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Punishment began to show before they could fully enjoy eating the tree, spoiling the pleasure; likewise, what a person chooses over God brings no true enjoyment.
rows.anchor: لم يحصل استيفاء من الأكل والاستمتاع به للنفس حتى ظهرت تباشير العقاب

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Whatever a person withholds from God, whether self, wealth, or anything else, loses blessing.
rows.anchor: وكذلك من ادخر عن الله - سبحانه - نفسه أو ماله أو شيئا بوجه من الوجوه - لا يبارك الله فيه

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Protection from Satan’s unseen gaze comes through inwardly seeing God, seeking His aid, and entering the shelter of His care.
rows.anchor: لا يحصل للعبد احتراس من رؤية الشيطان إياه وهو عنه غائب إلا برؤية العبد للحق - سبحانه - بقلبه

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Those who justify themselves by following their predecessors cling to a frail support, stumble through delusion, and fall into trial.
rows.anchor: استروحوا في التعلل إلى سلوكهم نهج أسلافهم ، فاستمسكوا بحبل واه

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Qist means justice, which applies in relation to God, other people, and oneself.
rows.anchor: القسط العدل ، ويقع ذلك في حق الله تعالى ، وفي حق الخلق ، وفي حق نفسك

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Justice toward God means keeping within the command without falling short in duties or committing prohibitions, withholding nothing entrusted to one, and preferring nothing over God among permitted things.
rows.anchor: فالعدل في حق الله الوقوف على حد الأمر من غير تقصير في المأمور به أو إقدام على المنهي عنه

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Justice toward other people means giving them fairness according to knowledge and, according to chivalry, relinquishing one’s own claim.
rows.anchor: وأما العدل مع الخلق - فعلى لسان العلم - بذل الإنصاف ، وعلى موجب الفتوة ترك الانتصاف

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Justice toward oneself means disciplining and restraining the soul, closing every door of ease to it, and opposing it in every circumstance and breath.
rows.anchor: وأما العدل في حق نفسك فإدخال العتق عليها ، وسد أبواب الراحة بكل وجه عليها

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Establishing one’s face and invoking God sincerely means sustaining awareness of His presence at every moment and in everything one does, leaves, advances, or delays.
rows.anchor: الإشارة منه إلى استدامة شهوده في كل حالة ، وألا تنساه لحظة في كل ما تأتيه وتذره

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Whomever God apportions happiness has a happy original disposition, state, and outcome; one whose allotment is the opposite has the reverse.
rows.anchor: من كانت قسمته - سبحانه - له بالسعادة كانت فطرته على السعادة ، وكانت حالته بنعت السعادة

rows.speaker: رسول الله
rows.claim: The Messenger says that a person will meet God in the condition in which that person was.
rows.anchor: قال رسول الله : ( من كان بحالة لقي الله بها )

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Predestination means God knows how each event will occur and wills it as He knows; what He knows will not occur, though possible, He wills not to occur, and the servant attains the condition already decreed.
rows.anchor: أن يتحقق أنه علم ما يكون أنه كيف يكون ، وأراد أن يكون كما علم

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: On the outward level, taking adornment at every mosque requires covering nakedness during prayer.
rows.anchor: على لسان العلم : يجب ستر العورة في الصلاة

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: On the inward level, a servant’s adornment is presence in the divine presence, remaining at its threshold, and sustaining witness to ultimate reality.
rows.anchor: وعلى موجب الإشارة : زينة العبد بحضور الحضرة ، ولزوم السدة ، واستدامة شهود الحقيقة

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The idols lack the bodily capacities and praiseworthy qualities their worshipers possess; it is incoherent to worship what is even more deficient than they are.
rows.anchor: بين بهذه الآيات أن الأصنام التي عبدوها دونهم فيما اعتقدوا فيه صفة المدح

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Knowing that the deity can guide and answer its petitioner makes the servant renounce personal power and single out God as able to meet needs and remove distress, cutting hope in creatures.
rows.anchor: وعلم العبد بقدرة معبوده يوجب تبريه عن حوله وقوته ، وإفراد الحق - سبحانه - بالقدرة على قضاء حاجته

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: True reliance on God means not caring about anything besides Him, since He alone controls benefit, harm, good, and evil.
rows.anchor: صدق التوكل على الله يوجب ترك المبالاة بغير الله

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Whoever fulfills God’s due is cared for sufficiently by Him; God directs the servant’s affairs with grace, and if He withholds a desired outcome, makes the servant content with what He does.
rows.anchor: من قام بحق الله تولى أموره على وجه الكفاية ، فلا يخرجه إلى مثاله

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The spirit of contentment bestowed on the innermost secrets is fuller than the comfort of receiving gifts in the heart.
rows.anchor: وروح الرضا على الأسرار أتم من راحة العطاء على القلوب

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Although idolaters saw their idols with their physical eyes, their inner hearts and secrets were veiled from true sight, so their seeing did not count.
rows.anchor: شاهدوه بأبصارهم لكنهم حجبوا عن رؤيته ببصائر أسرارهم وقلوبهم فلم يعتد برؤيتهم

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Seeing spiritual masters is not seeing their bodies; it is the heart’s unveiling of the unseen, in proportion to reverence and faith.
rows.anchor: رؤية الأكابر ليست بشهود أشخاصهم ، لكن بما يحصل للقلوب من مكاشفات الغيب

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: God’s generous way is a model for the Prophet, and a transmitted saying holds that believers receive good character from God.
rows.anchor: من خصائص سنة الله في الكرم أنه أمر نبيه - صلوات الله عليه وعلى آله - بالأخذ به

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The greater the offense, the more complete the reward in forgiving it; the servant’s rank in generosity is measured by pardoning inferiors and attendants.
rows.anchor: وكلما كان الجرم أكبر كان العفو عنه أجر وأكمل ، وعلى قدر عظم رتبة العبد في الكرم

rows.speaker: النبي
rows.claim: After being wounded at Uhud, the Prophet prayed that God forgive his people because they did not know.
rows.anchor: قال النبي في الجراحات التي أصابته في حرب أحد : ( اللهم اغفر لقومي فإنهم لا يعلمون )

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The highest form of recognized goodness is giving most generously to those who show the greatest hostility, as the Messenger treated people.
rows.anchor: أفضل العرف أن يكون أكمل العطاء لأكثر أهل الجفاء ، وبذلك عامل الرسول - صلى الله عليه وعلى آله - الناس

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Because some were forgiven and others punished despite sharing disbelief after faith, forgiveness and punishment depend on God’s will rather than a quality of the servants that would require equal treatment.
rows.anchor: فلما اشتركوا في الكفر بعد الإيمان ، وعفا عن بعضهم وعذب بعضهم دل على أنه يفعل ما يشاء

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Believers strengthen one another, whereas hypocrites mutually support one another like birds alighting among their own flock, helping companions persist in corruption and blinding them to guidance.
rows.anchor: فالمنافق لصاحبه أس به قوامه ، وأصل به قيامه ؛ يعينه على فساده ، ويعمي عليه طريق رشاده

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: A believer helps another see personal faults, makes sins hateful, supports the person on the right path, and distances them from corruption.
rows.anchor: ويبغض لديه ويقبح - في عينيه - ذنوبه ، وهو على السداد ينجده ، وعن الفساد يبعده

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The hypocrites’ withholding of their hands means that they do not ask God for their needs.
rows.anchor: عن طلب الحوائج من الله تعالى

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: God’s forgetting them is requital for their forgetting Him: they abandoned obedience and chose disobedience, so He left them to what they chose.
rows.anchor: جازاهم على نسيانهم ، فسمى جزاء النسيان نسيانا . تركوا طاعته ، وآثروا مخالفته

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Qushayri explains God’s abandonment by linking it to the description of people left in darkness, unable to see.
rows.anchor: قال تعالى : { وتركهم فى ظلمات لا يبصرون }

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Hypocrites face the promised fire in the hereafter and enduring torment now: its delayed form is burning, while its immediate form is separation.
rows.anchor: فمؤجل عذابهم الحرقة ، ومعجله الفرقة

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: One admonition tells hypocrites that they followed the path of earlier disbelievers and hypocrites, whom God already requited.
rows.anchor: سلكتم طريق من قبلكم من الكفار وأهل النفاق

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Another admonition says earlier peoples surpassed them in duration, strength, worldly enjoyment, and self-deception, yet their ease and resources failed them in hardship, and the same fate will soon reach these hypocrites.
rows.anchor: الذين تقدموكم زادوا عليكم فكافأناهم كما نكافئ أهل الشقاق والنفاق ؛ في كثرة المدة وقوة العدة

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Past nations were justly destroyed and scattered until none remained, and their history should warn that worldly advantage ends in disgrace.
rows.anchor: قضينا فيهم بالعدل ، وحكمنا باستئصال الكل ، فلم يبق منهم نافخ نار

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The faithful help one another obey, counsel one another to avoid prohibitions, love and accompany each other for God, oppose for God, and relinquish personal interests for His sake.
rows.anchor: يعين بعضهم بعضا على الطاعات ، ويتواصون بينهم بترك المحظورات ؛ فتحابهم في الله

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: God promises Paradise and good dwellings, but dwellings become truly pleasant through seeing the Beloved; people differ between attachment to benefits and being drawn by truth to the Real.
rows.anchor: ولا يطيب المسكن إلا برؤية المحبوب ، وكل محب يطيب مسكنه برؤية محبوبه ، ولكنهم مختلفون في الهمم

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Some find their home pleasant through the gift’s presence, while others find it pleasant through witnessing the Giver; an anonymous poem longs for the beloved’s home.
rows.anchor: قوم يطيب مسكنهم بوجود عطائه ، وقوم يطيب مسكنهم بشهود لقائه ، وأنشدوا

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The sign of those granted divine pleasure is that they taste it; the joy of intimacy is no less than the comfort of Paradise and is greater.
rows.anchor: وأمارة أهل الرضوان وجدان طعمه ؛ فهم في روح الأنس ، وروح الأنس لا يتقاصر عن راحة دار القدس

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The Prophet’s call to fight disbelievers and hypocrites is a summons to all people to cultivate good character.
rows.anchor: دعا نبينا - - كافة الخلق إلى حسن الخلق

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The instruction to Moses was to speak gently, while the Prophet was told to be stern; the two commands address different circumstances.
rows.anchor: قال لموسى عليه السلام : { فقولا له قولا لينا } [ طه : 44 ] . وقال لنبينا - - : { واغلظ عليهم }

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Severity applies after proofs have been shown and respite has removed excuses; the initial instruction was gentleness, but persistence and arrogance led to the later command.
rows.anchor: فلما أصروا واستكبروا أمره بالغلظة عليهم

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Struggle begins with explaining proof, then uses warning and rebuke after denial persists, and finally becomes combat if speech and admonition fail.
rows.anchor: والمجاهدة أولها اللسان لشرح البرهان ، وإيضاح الحجج والبيان

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The hypocrites hid behind oaths, but God exposed their secrets and stripped away their cover.
rows.anchor: تستروا بأيمانهم فهتك الله أستارهم وكشف أسرارهم

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Their word of disbelief was an attack on the Messenger’s prophethood; more generally, attributing human traits to God or divine attributes exclusive to God to creatures is disbelief.
rows.anchor: وهي طعنهم في نبوة رسول الله - - وكل من وصف المعبود بصفات الخلق

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Their unrealized schemes included killing the Messenger and claiming that the strongest would expel the weakest.
rows.anchor: وهموا بما لم ينالوا من قتل لرسول الله ، وما سولت أنفسهم أنه يخرج الأعز منها الأذل

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: A reported explanation says they wanted Islam’s political power to disappear, but God insisted on raising its cause.
rows.anchor: يقال تمنوا زوال دولة الإسلام فأبى الله إلا إعلاء أمرها

words: وَمَا نَقَمُوا۟ إِلَّآ أَنْ أَغْنَىٰهُمُ ٱللَّهُ وَرَسُولُهُۥ مِن فَضْلِهِۦ
rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: They criticized the very thing that was their greatest virtue, their enrichment by God and His Messenger, and thereby exposed themselves without excuse.
rows.anchor: أي ما عابوه إلا بما هو أجل خصاله ، فلم يحصلوا من ذلك إلا على ظهور شأنهم للكافة

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The strongest pillars of repentance are breaking the heart’s persistence in sin and then fulfilling the entire obligation as fully as possible.
rows.anchor: وأقوى أركان التوبة حل عقدة الإصرار عن القلب ، ثم القيام بجميع حق الأمر على وجه الاستقصاء

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Some firmly covenanted with God to give charity and be righteous if enriched, then broke that covenant when their request was granted and remained trapped in hypocrisy.
rows.anchor: منهم من أكد العقد مع الله ، ثم نقضه ، فلحقه شؤم ذلك ؛ فبقي خالدا في نفاقه

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: In the outward legal sense, miserliness is withholding what is obligatory; each person’s miserliness also takes a form suited to that person’s state.
rows.anchor: وحد البخل - على لسان العلم - منع الواجب . وبخل كل أحد على ما يليق بحاله

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Preferring anything over God’s pleasure is miserliness: a miser with wealth loses its blessing, one who withholds the self from obedience loses health, and one who withholds the spirit from God is forsaken until life becomes misery.
rows.anchor: وكل من آثر شيئا من دون رضاء ربه فقد اتصف ببخله ، فمن يبخل بماله تزل عنه البركة

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Their miserliness brought hypocrisy into their hearts; the verse may also be parsed as saying that God brought hypocrisy into their hearts.
rows.anchor: أعقبهم ببخلهم نفاقا في قلوبهم ، ويصح أعقبهم الله نفاقا في قلوبهم

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Breaking one’s covenant rejects affection at its root; whoever displays good while concealing evil has a share of hypocrisy.
rows.anchor: من نقض عهده في نفسه رفض الود من أصله ، وكل من أظهر في الجملة خيرا واستبطن شرا

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The hypocrite occupies the last rank in this world and the lowest depth of Hell in the next.
rows.anchor: والمنافق في الصف الأخير في دنياه ، وفي الدرك الأسفل من النار في عقباه

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: God warns them through His knowledge as He warns them elsewhere through His acts.
rows.anchor: خوفهم بعلمه كما خوفهم بفعله في أكثر من موضع من كتابه

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Their secret is what no one besides God can see.
rows.anchor: و { سرهم } ما لا يطلع عليه غير الله

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Their private conversation is what they say confidentially to one another; the term may also include thoughts surveyed by their own souls.
rows.anchor: و { نجواهم } ما يتسارون بعضهم مع بعض . ويحتمل أن يكون ما لنفوسهم عليه إشراف من خواطرهم

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: People who fail to understand treat their acts as small, but the gravity of an act comes from opposing the Almighty, not from its size; a little lawful provision is better than much that ends in ruin.
rows.anchor: وليس قدر الأجرام لأعيانها ، ولكن لمخالفة الجبار عظم شأنها ، قال تعالى : { وتحسبونه هينا وهو عند الله عظيم }

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Shuayb’s listeners answered his counsel with stubborn persistence in denial and ingratitude, relying on ignorance and imitation rather than reflection or insight into guidance.
rows.anchor: لم يقابلوا نصيحته لهم إلا بالعناد والتمادي فيما هو دائم من الجحد والكنود

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: A clear proof is a light that lets one perceive what is hidden beneath the covering of heedlessness.
rows.anchor: البينة نور تستبصر به ما خفي عليك تحت غطاء الغفلة

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Good provision sustains independence and comes from God’s primordial care and good governance of a person’s welfare, completing blessing and preserving protection.
rows.anchor: والرزق الحسن ما به دوام الاستقلال ، وما ذلك إلا مقتضى عنايته الأزلية

rows.speaker: قيل
rows.claim: One reported view defines good provision as what a person strives to obtain but receives without fatigue.
rows.anchor: وقيل الرزق الحسن ما تعني صاحبه لطلبه ، ولم يصبه نصب بسببه

rows.speaker: قيل
rows.claim: Another reported view defines good provision as what one receives while witnessing it as provision and retaining awareness of the Provider while enjoying it.
rows.anchor: وقيل الرزق الحسن ما يستوفيه بشهود الرزق ويحفظه عند التنعم بوجود الرزاق

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: A further saying defines good provision as what does not make its recipient forget the Provider and instead moves the recipient to generosity and spending.
rows.anchor: ويقال الرزق الحسن ما لا ينسي الرزاق ، ويحمل صاحبه على التوسعة والإنفاق

words: وَمَآ أُرِيدُ أَنْ أُخَالِفَكُمْ إِلَىٰ مَآ أَنْهَىٰكُمْ عَنْهُ
rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: A preacher may be lenient about what he commands, since performing every duty is impossible, but must not permit what he forbids, since avoiding all prohibitions is obligatory.
rows.anchor: فإن الإتيان بجميع الطاعات غير ممكن ، ولكن التجرد عن جميع المحرمات واجب

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: A person who cannot restrain their own soul from desire has no authority to guide others toward right guidance.
rows.anchor: من لم يكن له حكم على نفسه في المنع عن الهوى لم يكن له حكم على غيره

words: إِنْ أُرِيدُ إِلَّا ٱلْإِصْلَٰحَ مَا ٱسْتَطَعْتُ
rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Good intention to reform what one can is central to action, and God joins it with facilitation; when someone intends evil, God leaves that person to obstruction.
rows.anchor: مدار الأمر إلى الأغراض المقضية حسن القصد بالإصلاح ، فيقرن الله به حسن التيسير

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: In religious usage, enabling success is the capacity by which obedience is performed; more broadly, divinely supplied motives and means of obedience count as enabling success.
rows.anchor: وفي الشريعة التوفيق ما تنفق به الطاعة ، وهو قدرة الطاعة ، ثم كل ما تقرب العبد به من الطاعة

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Enabling success comes through and from God, who bestows it as a gracious favor.
rows.anchor: والتوفيق بالله ومن الله ، وهو - سبحانه - بإعطائه متفضل

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Reliance delegates one’s affairs to God; its sign is leaving personal planning through witness of the decree and trusting the promise when its fulfillment is not yet present.
rows.anchor: التوكل تفويض الأمر إلى الله ، وأمارته ترك التدبير بشهود التقدير

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The darkness of a rain cloud is followed by gardens rejoicing: the sky’s weeping gives the garden its laughter, as a poem says.
rows.anchor: فما لم تبك السماء لا يضحك الروض ، كما قيل : ومأتم فيه السماء تبكي

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: In the inward analogy, a cloud of longing forms in the heart, thoughts fluctuate, then reality appears and the spirit rejoices in intimacy and nearness.
rows.anchor: كذلك تنشأ في القلب سحابة الطلب ، فيحصل للقلب تردد الخاطر ، ثم يلوح وجه الحقيقة

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The angels too glorify God out of fear of Him.
rows.anchor: أي الملائكة أيضا تسبح من خوفه تعالى

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The heart can know longing, groaning, and breathless anguish; angels who see the hearts of spiritual seekers weep blood for them, especially when one lapses, since a lapse is a lightning strike in this path.
rows.anchor: والملائكة إذا حصل لهم على قلوب المريدين - خصوصا - اطلاع يبكون دما لأجلهم ، لا سيما إذا وقعت لواحد منهم فترة

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The summons of truth shines in hearts through proof; whoever listens with understanding responds to the evidence of knowledge.
rows.anchor: دواعي الحق تصير لائحة في القلوب من حيث البرهان فمن استمع إليها بسمع الفهم

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Satan’s promptings call a servant to sin by making it attractive; whoever listens with heedlessness answers the voice of error.
rows.anchor: دواعي الشيطان التي تهتف بالعبد بتزيين المعاصي ، فمن أصغى إليها بسمع الغفلة استجاب لصوت الغي

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The lower soul leads by the reins of self-interest; whoever leans toward its promptings falls into the humiliation of the veil.
rows.anchor: ومعها دواعي النفس وهي قائدة للعبد بزمام الحظوظ ، فمن ركن إليها ولاحظها وقع في هوان الحجاب

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The calls of truth arrive without an angelic intermediary, rational proof, or scholarly sign; when God makes a servant hear them, the servant necessarily responds to God through God.
rows.anchor: ودواعي الحق تكون بلا واسطة ملك ، ولا بدلالة عقل ، ولا بإشارة علم

words: وَمَا دُعَآءُ ٱلْكَٰفِرِينَ إِلَّا فِى ضَلَٰلٍۢ
rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: In the spiritual path, the soul’s promptings call to a kind of idolatry: seeing something of oneself, imagining claims for oneself, dwelling in separation, and being blind to the realities of union.
rows.anchor: هواجس النفس ودواعيها تدعو - في الطريقة - إلى الشرك ، وذلك بشهود شيء منك ، وحسبان أمر لك

rows.speaker: أهل التفسير
rows.claim: Exegetes say the believer prostrates to God voluntarily, while affliction forces the believer to humble themself; this is the meaning of prostrating under compulsion.
rows.anchor: المؤمن يسجد لله طوعا ، وإذا نزل به ضر ألجأه إلى أن يتواضع ويسجد ، وذلك معنى سجوده كرها - وهذا قول أهل التفسير

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: A disbeliever may prostrate willingly to seek relief from harm, but this too counts as compelled prostration; likewise, prostration for reward or to remove an ordeal is directed by need.
rows.anchor: والكافر يسجد طائعا مختارا ، ولكن لما كان سجوده لطلب كشف الضر قال تعالى

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Prostration has two kinds: prostration of the self, which is familiar, and prostration of the heart, which belongs to spiritual presence.
rows.anchor: ويقال السجود على قسمين : ساجد بنفسه وساجد بقلبه ؛ فسجود النفس معهود ، وسجود القلب من حيث الوجود
